text:
maria: Heads up - ACME reporting 503s and timeouts across a handful of routes. Spike started ~10:12 UTC, looks correlated with hosted infer upstream worker restarts.
sam: seeing ~20% 5xx on /v1/generate for their org, error shows: 'upstream closed connection' then container restart.
ryan: logs from runner: kernel: invalid opcode at 0x7f2a... then segfault, also GPU OOM events right before SIGSEGV. attaching snippet from dmesg: 'NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:81:00): 79'
maria: customer is on production traffic. They're seeing client retries, latency 1.2s -> 3s -> 10s then 503. CS flagged billing concerns because of retries incrementing token counts. jess-cs: I'm on the call in 15m, we need an immediate mitigation and a customer note.
sam: quick mitigation: set routing policy to fallback to model-variant:small-1 for their org and reduce batch size to 1. That will lower throughput but should avoid OOM.
ryan: agreed. pushing policy change now: api:PATCH /admin/routing -> { "org": "acme", "fallback": "small-1", "max_batch": 1 }
deploy-bot: canary update started for routing policy -> 3 nodes.
support-bot: acked and applied for org acme, will take ~45s to propagate.
maria: also noticed we recently rolled quantized runtime 2.1.0 to hosted. Could be hitting a regression with kv-prefetch and large context sizes. Any repro steps?
ryan: repro locally: curl -X POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"large-q","context":"<~120k tokens>","max_tokens":2048,"stream":false}' -> after ~30s worker shows OOM then segfault. attaching trimmed backtrace: 'infer_runner(+0x12f4c) [0x55a2f]' 'libc.so.6(__libc_start_main)'.
sam: good repro, can reproduce on a small cluster with 2xA100. suggests a memory leak under specific long context + quantized path.
maria: action list: 1) keep fallback routing active 2) throttle their QPS via per-org rate limiter 3) roll back quantized runtime on hosted until root cause.
jess-cs: I need exact wording for customer note: short, admit impact, mitigation (fallback + rate limit), ETA for full resolution. I'll draft after we confirm rollback.
ryan: starting rollback of runtime 2.1.0 -> 2.0.7 on hosted. rolling 20% -> 60% -> 100%. deploy-bot: rollback job #867 started, first batch succeeded.
sam: monitoring metrics now - errors down from 20% to 4% after routing fallback. latency back to baseline for most requests.
maria: billing question - CS asking if we should provide credits for retries billing spike. jess-cs: yes recommend credit for excess during incident window 10:12-10:35 UTC. tag finance after postmortem.
ryan: capturing logs and core dumps to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/1758881234/cores/. Also filing a reproducible test in eng-ml with exact payload.
sam: we should add a guard in runtime: if context_tokens > 64k and model is quantized, refuse request with 4xx and suggest smaller context or non-quantized variant. filing issue INF-4921.
maria: agreed. tagging @eng-runtime and @eng-ml in the follow-up. jess-cs: customer call done, they appreciate the quick fallback and will hold for postmortem. I'll send comms + credit offer.
ryan: current status: rollback complete, errors back to normal, routing fallback still active while we validate. leaving this thread open until we have root cause.
maria: thanks all. please paste postmortem link here when ready. :thumbsup:
